summary: Distinguish Bitcoin RPC failures from mining readiness and retry transient observations
details: AssumeUTXO mining checks distinguish RPC timeouts, authentication and response errors, helper failures, and confirmed baseline or foreground unreadiness.
Transient Bitcoin observations receive at most three fresh attempts within a shared 45-second deadline; permanent failures and identity mismatches remain blocking.
Bitcoin status exposes safe method, failure kind and error-code metadata; older runtime reports retain generic diagnostics and bounded retries.
Background historical validation remains independent of mining readiness throughout the role-switch transaction.
operator_actions: Install the updated node tools and activate the matching release to receive detailed diagnostics from the Bitcoin runtime.
